welcome--docs.content:
import { Meta } from "@storybook/addon-docs/blocks"; import { Chapter, SymbolLine } from '../src/shared-components/Chapter.tsx';

Welcome to the Synergy Design System

Synergy is the foundation to efficiently build a consistent digital landscape for **[SICK](https://www.sick.com)**.
Synergy gives you a head start for your application. Use colors, styles, components and assets to quickly spin-up your application in development ✍ and design 🎨 at the same time. Build multiple apps with different frameworks sharing the same UI components.


}>The source code is available on [GitHub](https://github.com/synergy-design-system/synergy-design-system)
}>The Figma files are available on Figma for SICK users only.
}>[with vanilla JS](../?path=/docs/packages-components-web-components--docs)
}>[with Angular](../?path=/docs/packages-components-angular-wrapper--docs)
}>[with React](../?path=/docs/packages-components-react-wrapper--docs)
}>[with Vue](../?path=/docs/packages-components-vue-wrapper--docs)
- Design-Tokens, Assets, Components, Styles and Templates - Modular and flexible UI components which can be put together like Lego blocks. - The components exist twice; as web- (development) and as Figma-components (design) which are always in-sync and have the exact same anatomy. - [Angular](https://angular.io), [React](https://react.dev) and [Vue](https://vuejs.org) are first-class citizens. Due to the nature of web-components which are framework agnostic they run in all frameworks or without any. But we decided to give special support to those popular frameworks so they profit from better DX. - The web-components are accessible (A11Y) - Auto-completion in TS, JS and HTML (VSCode) - Customizability: easy and profound options for styling and branding via DesignTokens, CSS Variables and CSS Parts. - Light and dark themes are included - Material icons - Support for all major browsers; tested with every release. - Basic CSS styles for an easy application start - Templates for typical and recurring UIs which can be copied.
- The [web-components](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Web_components) are build upon popular technologies, especially [Lit](https://lit.dev) and [Shoelace](https://shoelace.style) 🙏 - [Material Icons](https://fonts.google.com/icons) from Google 🙏
Our roadmap is an up-to-date report on the work we’re doing and planning to do. New features and components are added continuously. Like each roadmap, it is always subject to change and dates are just an orientation. It should give you an idea what to expect in the upcoming months. The roadmap can be found on [GitHub](https://github.com/synergy-design-system/synergy-design-system/wiki/Component-development-state-and-Roadmap).
Most parts are MIT License. Exception are the Logos inside the _assets_ folder
}>From our hearts to yours - the Synergy team.

principles-and-vision--docs.content:
import { Meta } from '@storybook/addon-docs/blocks'; # Guiding principles and vision of the Synergy Design System ## Guiding principles

The Synergy Design System serves as a robust foundation for SICK's digital landscape, built upon three core principles which should be kept in mind by designers, developers and stakeholders.

### Progressive – Guiding into Tomorrow We stay ahead, making our design system more flexible for our brand's future needs, while keeping it easy for users. ### Unified – Building Together, Always As developers and designers we shape a single product by learning from and being responsible for each other. ### Connected – Building on Trust We build on trusted vendors, proven standards and the expertise of our community, to focus on what's relevant for our brand and users. These principles help us to achieve our goals. ## Vision, mission and goals ### Vision

Synergy is the foundation to efficiently build a consistent digital landscape for SICK.

### Mission Synergies mission is to empower teams to create user-friendly, adaptable, and accessible products across all digital platforms through a unified, collaborative, and evolving UI design system. Synergy ensures high-quality, consistent interfaces aligned with our brand values, enhancing productivity and scalability for teams. Additionally, it improves usability and accessibility for a diverse user base, driving efficient, coherent, and inclusive product development. ### Goals #### Consistency and branding - Ensure user interface consistency and quality - Harmonized user experience for all SICK customers - Strengthen brand perception - Ensure accessibility #### Efficiency and productivity - Boost productivity of domain teams - Develop user-centric and focus at stakeholders - Design (Figma) and development (Web components) are always in-sync - Enable teams to rapidly prototype and iterate - Ensure the scalability as the digital ecosystem expands - Favor standards and make reuse as much as possible #### Flexibility and adaptation - Provide means to flexible adapt and customize the components - Allow users to integrate components in every web application #### Collaboration and communication - Transparency towards and alignment with stakeholders - Involve stakeholders in decision processes and development (contribution)

import { Meta } from "@storybook/addon-docs/blocks";

<Meta title="Accessibility" tags={['Accessibility']} />

# Accessibility

## What's it all about?

In today's digital age, ensuring that web applications are accessible to everyone is not just a legal requirement but a moral imperative.
Accessibility in web development means designing and building websites and applications that can be used by people of all abilities and disabilities.
This includes individuals with visual, auditory, motor, and cognitive impairments.

## Why accessibility matters?

**Inclusivity**: Accessibility ensures that everyone, regardless of their abilities, can access and use our web applications.
This inclusivity fosters a more diverse and equitable digital environment.

**Legal compliance**: Many countries have laws and regulations that require digital content to be accessible.
Non-compliance can lead to legal repercussions and damage to the company's reputation.

**Enhanced user experience**: Accessible design often leads to a better overall user experience.
Features like keyboard navigation, contrast, readable text benefit all users, not just those with disabilities.

**Market reach**: By making our web applications accessible, we can reach a broader audience, including the millions of people with disabilities worldwide.

## Accessibility in design systems
A design system is a collection of reusable components and guidelines that ensure consistency and efficiency in design and development.
Just like our base library and role model [Shoelace](https://shoelace.style/resources/accessibility) we promise to build each component with accessibility in mind.

### Key aspects
**Component-level accessibility**: Each component in our design system is built to be accessible.
This includes ensuring proper color contrast, keyboard navigability and screen reader compatibility.

**Holistic approach**: While component-level accessibility is crucial, it's not the whole picture.
Accessibility must be integrated into the entire application. This means considering the user journey,
ensuring that all interactions are accessible, and testing the application with real users who have disabilities.

**Progressive approach**: Accessibility is not a binary (yes/no) and not a one-time task either but an ongoing process.
We strive to making Synergy as accessibility as possible and improve it continuously.
As Synergy evolves, we continuously test and improve our components to meet the latest accessibility standards and best practices.

## Our commitment to accessibility
We are committed to making Synergy components accessible to everyone, so we decided to make it part of our Definition-of-Done.
Synergy is always developed with accessibility in mind, ensuring that every component is usable by all users.
We believe that accessibility is a fundamental aspect of good design and are dedicated to continuously improving our practices to create a more inclusive digital world.

import { Meta } from "@storybook/addon-docs/blocks"; import { getAvailableBaselines } from "@synergy-design-system/browser-baseline"; import { formatBrowserBaseline, formatVersionDisplay, compareVersions } from "../../../src/browsersupport"; # Browser Support Synergy is designed to work across a wide range of browsers, ensuring that our components are accessible and functional for as many users as possible. To achieve this, we define a set of browser baselines that specify the minimum versions of browsers that Synergy supports. They are created based on `baseline widely available` and fixed during the first release of a major Synergy version. This means that the browser baselines for a given Synergy version will not change until the next major release, even if there are updates to browser usage or new versions of browsers are released. > Synergies baselines are usually updated once for each new major Synergy release to reflect changes in browser usage and to ensure that we are providing the best possible experience for our users. {getAvailableBaselines().sort(compareVersions).map(baseline => ( ))}
